profile_text.body:
Scite is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, that operates an AI-powered platform for searching and evaluating scientific literature. The company describes itself as built on the largest licensed database of scholarly content in AI research, with agreements across 40+ publishers plus the full open access corpus. Its platform searches 300 million or more scholarly articles and has indexed 1.6 billion or more citations, serving 2 million users worldwide.

The core product, also called Scite, centers on Smart Citations, which show how later research has supported, challenged, or discussed a given paper, claim, method, journal, author, institution, or funder. An AI Assistant uses those same citation signals to produce answers grounded in the broader literature, with every claim linked back to the specific sentence in the specific source paper. The company describes its approach as distinct from tools that summarize without accessing full text, noting that when other tools hit a paywall, Scite reads the paper. Scite is noted as now part of Research Solutions.

The held facts list 299 legal matters associated with the state of New York, and Scite has a registered Model Context Protocol server, ai.scite/mcp, described as grounding answers in scientific literature through full-text search, trust evaluation, and full-text article access.
